messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Please share **either**:
1) your **email address**, **or**
2) your **first name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I confirm your user identity, please also tell me the **order ID** (e.g., `#W0000000`) and which **items** you want to **return or cancel**.

Sure! My email is mia.garcia2723@example.com.

I’ll get the order ID for you—just a moment.
mia_garcia_4516

Thanks—I've found your account (**user id: mia_garcia_4516**).

Thanks for confirming my account! The order ID is #W4589231.
